title: Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans 2nd edition
doc_summary:
Here are 7 concise bullet points focusing on recommendations and behavior-change measures:
* Move more and sit less to improve health and reduce chronic disease risk
* Aim for regular physical activity to maintain or improve overall health
* Incorporate aerobic and muscle-strengthening activities into daily routine
* Start with small amounts of physical activity and gradually increase duration and intensity
* Eliminate the need for physical activity to occur in bouts of at least 10 minutes
* Use tested strategies to increase physical activity levels, such as community-level interventions
* Make physical activity a priority at individual, school, workplace, and community levels to promote a healthier nation
